description: Defines the interface and implementation details for a file abstraction supporting asynchronous and synchronous IO operations within the disk cache component of Chromium. Includes class declarations for File and FileIOCallback, with methods for file initialization, reading, writing, and managing IO operations.

classes.name: FileIOCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback upon completion of asynchronous file IO operations.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A wrapper around a file that supports asynchronous and synchronous IO operations, with reference counting.

methods.name: explicit File(bool mixed_mode)
methods.description: Constructor that sets whether the file operates in mixed (sync/async) mode.

methods.name: explicit File(base::File file)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the File object with an existing base::File.

methods.name: bool Init(const base::FilePath& name)
methods.description: Initializes the file with the given path.

methods.name: bool IsValid() const
methods.description: Checks if the file was successfully opened.

methods.description: Sets the file length, truncating or extending with zeros.
